svg.title: Становая тяга на прямых ногах со штангой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Stiff-leg deadlift with a barbell. Use strict three-quarter side view. Left start: standing upright, feet hip width, holding one straight loaded barbell with both hands at thigh level, arms hanging straight. Right: pelvis pushed backward, trunk hinges forward at hip with neutral spine, knees stay almost straight but soft with only a few degrees of bend, arms hanging vertically and bar close to upper shins. Bar clear of the floor. Same feet and nearly identical knee bend. Do not squat or bend the elbows. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
